title: WO-004 dev component spec fails typecheck and 8 of its e2e tests (in progress at WO-001 close)
detail: At 18:40 'npm run typecheck' reports 5 TS errors, all in this file: line 182 (string|number passed as string), lines 273-274 (a viewport table of type number|{width,height} used as test.use viewport). 'npx playwright test tests/e2e/dev/components' had 8 failing tests (WhitePoint disc 0 px at DPR 1/2, vertex-dot centre x3, HTML-host placement, setAttrs restore, transform/opacity-only write). WO-001 declared window.__gallery (any) in site/js/types.d.ts, which removed the other 13 errors. These keep repo-wide verify:quick red (step 1) until WO-004 fixes them; the WO-001 skeleton alone is green (verify exit 0 on a tree without this dir).
